lines.speaker: Elder Kwame
lines.text: Artie! Thank the ancestors you are here. Those mercenaries... they took the idol.

lines.speaker: Elder Kwame
lines.text: Their camp is to the north. The idol is locked in one of their chests. Get it back — before they move it off the island.

choices.label: Tell me more about the idol.

lines.speaker: Lil Artie
lines.text: Don't worry, Elder. I'll bring it home.

lines.speaker: Elder Kwame
lines.text: The Golden Idol has been in our family for generations. It holds the memory of our ancestors. Without it... we lose that connection.

lines.speaker: Elder Kwame
lines.text: You found it! The ancestors smile on you today, Artie.

lines.speaker: Elder Kwame
lines.text: Take this map — it shows something I have never told anyone. There is more treasure on this island... and more danger.
